title: Panda Video Compress & Convert
summary: Batch compress, convert & resize videos in seconds with no visible quality loss.
description:
🐼 Panda – Video Compressor & Video Converter (HD Video Compressor). Compress videos fast and easily with no visible quality loss!

💾 FREE UP STORAGE
Videos fill up your phone's memory and stop you from capturing new moments. Panda compresses videos, resizes videos, converts video formats and changes codecs — reduce file sizes instead of deleting them.

📶 SAVE YOUR DATA
Limited data plan? Shrink your videos with Panda – Video Compressor and send files using less data, saving for you and your recipient.

📤 SEND EVEN WITH A WEAK SIGNAL
A weak signal means endless uploads — or failures. Compress, resize and convert videos with Panda to solve the problem.

🗂️ BATCH VIDEO COMPRESSION
The free version compresses up to 3 videos simultaneously. Premium — unlimited!

🎥 RECORD AND SEND DIRECTLY
With Panda, record videos, compress files and send them — all within one app.

⭐ VIDEO COMPRESSOR & VIDEO CONVERTER: ALL FEATURES
● Compress videos → keep 4K and HD video quality while saving storage
● Resize videos → change video dimensions and resolution
● Reduce file size → GB, MB, KB
● Edit videos → cut, trim, remove the middle part
● Convert video format → MKV to MP4, AVI, FLV, RMVB, 3GP, MPEG, WebM, WMV, MOV
● Change video codec → H.264, HEVC (H.265), VP9 and more
● Replace files → automatically replace large files with compressed versions
● Email-ready → shrink videos for Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo & AOL
● MMS, text and SMS ready
● Post to Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, Discord & TikTok
● Send videos via WhatsApp, Viber & Telegram
● Resize videos for your website or online store
● Preserve video metadata

✅ GOOD QUALITY, SMALL FILE
Compress videos, resize videos, edit videos and convert formats — there's always a way to reduce video file sizes without losing quality.

✂️ CUT AND TRIM YOUR VIDEOS
Don't waste data on a boring intro. Cut the beginning and end, remove the middle part, delete unwanted sections. Save and send only what you need.

📐 CHANGE VIDEO RESOLUTION
Panda makes it easy to reduce resolution with one tap: 640×480, 1024×768, 1600×1200 and more — including full 4K and HD.

🔄 CONVERT VIDEO FORMAT
Panda – Video Format Converter supports conversion between: MP4, AVI, MKV, FLV, RMVB, 3GP, MPEG, WebM, WMV and MOV.

⚙️ CHANGE VIDEO CODEC
Change the video codec from H.264 to H.265, VP9 and more.

📧 EMAIL-READY
Want to share a video by email but the file is too large? Use the 'Email-ready' option to resize it perfectly for Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo & AOL.

🏆 PREMIUM
● Batch video compression → compress more than 3 videos simultaneously
● No ads → clean, uninterrupted experience
● No promo text → removed from shared videos
● Email support → direct help from our team
● Support our development → help us build better tools

🔒 PRIVACY
Panda performs all compression, resizing, conversion and editing operations directly on your phone. We never see your videos and never sell your usage data to third parties.
